snippet.title: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🕵️‍♀️ In Forensics: Crime Scene Detective, you step into the role of forensic specialists uncovering the truth behind complex criminal cases. 

🔬 Examine evidence in the lab, secure clues at the crime scene, and make decisions that bring the truth to light.

Developed in collaboration with the LKA Rhineland-Palatinate.

🎮 Coming Soon:
🔹 PS5 ➡ https://links.aerosoft.com/ForensicsPS5
🔹 Xbox Series X|S ➡ Coming soon!
🔹 PC ➡ https://links.aerosoft.com/Forensics
